purpose: Audit the private lossless RawElement bridge until the remaining non-core SysML productions receive handwritten AST nodes.
public_contract: RawElement is not a semantic model node. It is permitted only for the deferred productions listed here or parser-recovery fragments; downstream semantic code must reject or explicitly account for it.

entries.reason: featureElement still covers the broad feature, step, expression, invariant, connector, binding, succession, flow, and succession-flow family; those alternatives need distinct typed nodes and cannot be represented by a single guessed field layout.
entries.follow_up: Introduce explicit nodes for each featureElement alternative and remove this bridge only after field-level equality and round-trip tests exist.

entries.reason: Shares the same unresolved featureElement alternatives as typeFeatureMember while preserving a different grammar-owned prefix.
entries.follow_up: Add explicit owned-feature nodes with the required prefix ownership before deleting the fallback.

entries.scope: generic feature alternatives and return-feature bridge
entries.reason: The production is a dispatcher for several broad non-state families; ReturnFeatureMember intentionally retains its source until those families are typed.
entries.follow_up: Replace the dispatcher fallback with explicit feature/step/connector/flow nodes and update ReturnFeatureMember's field type.

entries.reason: Only actionBodyItem and returnParameterMember are currently assembled; malformed or newly introduced body alternatives must remain lossless instead of being dropped.
entries.follow_up: Add typed calculation-body members for every grammar alternative and turn missing child assembly into an explicit diagnostic.

entries.reason: subjectMember, actorMember, objectiveMember, and related requirement vocabulary are outside the current typed AST slice.
entries.follow_up: Model each case-member relationship explicitly and preserve its source mapping.

entries.reason: Requirement-specific constraint, concern, verification, actor, and stakeholder members are not yet part of the source AST contract.
entries.follow_up: Introduce explicit requirement relationship nodes before exposing requirement members to semantic analysis.

entries.reason: viewRenderingMember is not yet typed; retaining the complete fragment protects round-trip behavior.
entries.follow_up: Add typed view-rendering and filter relationship nodes.

entries.reason: expose and viewRenderingMember alternatives are not yet typed in the public source AST.
entries.follow_up: Model expose and rendering members with explicit fields and source spans.

entries.reason: The typed reference, attribute, enumeration, binding, and succession alternatives are passed through when assembled; an unassembled child remains lossless during staged coverage.
entries.follow_up: Convert any remaining unassembled interface alternative into a dedicated node and make the fallback unreachable for valid input.

entries.reason: Default ends, end occurrences, structure usages, and behavior usages are typed when their child callback succeeds; parser recovery or an unimplemented child is retained losslessly.
entries.follow_up: Remove the recovery fallback after all interface occurrence alternatives have explicit callbacks.

entries.reason: The listed action/state/requirement/case/viewpoint alternatives are dispatched explicitly; an absent assembled child is retained rather than silently omitted.
entries.follow_up: Make every behavior alternative typed and replace the fallback with a structured unsupported-production diagnostic.

entries.reason: A parser-recovered or not-yet-typed definition/non-occurrence alternative cannot be safely coerced into a concrete definition node.
entries.follow_up: Cover every definitionBodyItemContent alternative with a typed node and preserve visibility/prefix ownership.

entries.reason: variantReference and any child whose explicit callback is not yet assembled remain lossless; ordinary typed variant children are passed through.
entries.follow_up: Add the missing variant-reference and relationship nodes.

entries.reason: All currently implemented structure alternatives pass through; an unassembled alternative is retained until its concrete node exists.
entries.follow_up: Complete typed coverage for the remaining structure usages and delete the fallback.

entries.reason: Comment, documentation, and metadataFeature are typed; textualRepresentation is intentionally deferred and must not be confused with ordinary trivia.
entries.follow_up: Add a typed TextualRepresentation node with its model-owned fields.

entries.reason: Definitions are passed through only after their concrete callback assembles a SourceElement; unknown or recovered alternatives are retained instead of dropped.
entries.follow_up: Close the fallback once every pinned grammar definition alternative has a typed AST node and oracle.

entries.reason: Reference, end feature, default reference, attribute, and enumeration usages are passed through; extendedUsage remains outside the current typed slice.
entries.follow_up: Add typed extended-usage support and remove the dispatcher fallback.

entries.reason: Structure and behavior usage children are passed through when assembled; malformed/recovered alternatives are retained losslessly.
entries.follow_up: Make the fallback unreachable for valid input after all occurrence alternatives are typed.

entries.reason: Known import, alias, definition, structure, and non-occurrence members are passed explicitly; an unexpected member is retained rather than dropped.
entries.follow_up: Add explicit nodes for any newly introduced non-behavior member alternatives.

entries.reason: Valid package members, filters, aliases, and imports are passed through; the raw branch is reached only when ANTLR recovery leaves an incomplete dispatcher child.
entries.follow_up: Keep until malformed-input recovery has a structured error node/diagnostic contract.
